name: WikiWhy
description: WikiWhy is a question answering dataset focused on cause-and-effect questions, containing over 9,000 why-question-answer-rationale triples grounded in Wikipedia facts. It requires models to provide explicit natural language rationales explaining why an answer is true, serving as a benchmark for reasoning capabilities of large language models.
reputation: WikiWhy is a relatively niche but recognized reasoning benchmark in the LLM community, mainly used in research on explanation generation and causal reasoning rather than as a standard leaderboard task.
notes: Emphasizes explicit rationale generation for answers; GPT-3 baselines achieve 38.7% human-evaluated correctness.
